method.name: analogical-outline-interviews
method.control: Competent conventional brief-led investigator follows useful leads and prepares cited discovery then plan-comparison draft.
method.treatment: Retrieve TWO analogous real workflows/product feature taxonomies, derive FOUR distinct inquiry lenses including original user obligations. Conduct grounded answer-conditioned follow-up inquiry in each lens: each later question must use the preceding sourced answer, with irrelevant analogy categories explicitly rejected. One investigator context, same tools/time; no added scouts or search cap. Map obligations and discovered alternatives to lens/evidence; ordinary full criticism and revision follow.
method.novelty: Query-generation state transitions from analogy-derived lenses + source-conditioned interviews, rather than parallel scout roles/shared flat inventory.
method.adaptation_limit: Paper/implementation mechanisms motivate the intervention; published benchmark gains are NOT ER11 evidence.
